# Apple Music Playlist Toolkit v1.3.0

This stable release makes natural-language, LLM-native playlist curation the primary MCP workflow.

## Highlights

- `am_resolve_candidates` grounds a generous model-proposed pool in real Apple Music metadata,
  preserves input order, and flags unmatched tracks, duplicate recordings, version markers, and
  artist concentration without pretending to score taste.
- `create_playlist_from_description` now guides the host model through candidate generation,
  catalog grounding, direct natural-language comparison, narrative roles, dry-run, and creation.
- `am_optimize_order` remains available as an optional, read-only sequencing pass inside
  model-chosen narrative blocks; it no longer accepts arbitrary LLM score axes.
- Apple `hasLyrics=false` is treated as unknown rather than evidence that a track is instrumental.
- All nine localized README entry points, MCP client guides, the Cordis/DSH preset, and the agent
  skill describe the same 13-tool workflow.
- Invalid lone Unicode surrogate characters are rejected before a write handler runs, while valid
  UTF-8 Chinese and accented text continue to round-trip over stdio.

## Upgrade

```bash
pip install --upgrade "apple-music-playlists @ git+https://github.com/Z-Han-Z/apple-music-playlists.git@v1.3.0"
```

Existing credentials and caches remain in the same locations. No re-login or migration is
required. See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Z-Han-Z/apple-music-playlists/blob/v1.3.0/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete changes.
